text.en: Chain body shots to gain bonus damage on your next precision shot and return ammo to the magazine.
Chain body shots to gain bonus damage on your next precision shot and return ammo to the magazine.

Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each <title refills [G_refill] /> 3 ammo and grants 1 stack of 'Fate of All Fools'. Buff is removed on reload.

Non-precision hits consume one stack of Fate of All Fools and make the shot deal precision damage.

Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each <title refills [G_refill] /> 3 ammo and grants 1 stack of 'Fate of All Fools'. Maximum of 15 stacks. 

Fate of All Fools increases Stability by ? per stack and grants 100% increased damage to Firefly explosions.

Non-precision hits consume one stack of Fate of All Fools and make the shot deal precision damage.
